description: The line plot titled "ChatGPT on Songs" illustrates the relationship between the popularity of answers and the performance metrics of accuracy and confidence for a language model. The x-axis, labeled "Answer Popularity," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis, labeled "Values," is also a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. There are three lines on the plot, each representing a different metric. The blue line, marked with circles and a solid line style, represents "Accuracy." It starts at a value of approximately 0.6 at the 20 mark on the x-axis, peaks at around 0.8 near the 40 mark, and then gradually declines to just below 0.8 by the 160 mark. The green line, marked with triangles and a solid line style, represents "Confidence." It starts at a value of approximately 0.9 at the 20 mark, remains relatively stable with slight fluctuations, and ends at a value of around 0.95 by the 160 mark. The red line, marked with squares and a solid line style, is not visible in the provided image.
